jobs.description:
We are Covestro. We are curious. We are courageous. We are colorful. We refine chemical material solutions with game-changing products. Let us empower you to push boundaries. Join us and our 18.000 colleagues now and together we will make the world a brighter place.

Shape the digital identity of tomorrow with us

You want to make a real technological impact at a globally operating chemical company? At Covestro, we combine a drive for innovation with a clear commitment to sustainability – and we're looking for people who embody both.

As a Microsoft Active Directory Architect (m/f/d) in our Identity and Access Management team, you will play a key role in advancing our digital identity infrastructure. You will shape how Covestro accesses its systems securely and efficiently across the globe – with real creative latitude, direct collaboration with leadership bodies and global partners, and an environment that values technical depth just as much as out-of-the-box thinking.

In addition to our diverse benefits, a full-time position comes with an attractive starting salary between €89,400/year and €108,500/year plus a variable component. The starting salary is based on your qualifications and professional experience.

What awaits you in this role:

- You develop strategy, technical design and architectural guidelines for our company-wide IAM and Active Directory environment
- Together with your IAM colleagues, you drive the transformation to modern identity and directory technologies – including shared ownership of relevant roadmap workstreams and regular communication of status and progress
- Identifying innovative technology solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency and minimise risks is equally part of your responsibilities
- You support engineering and operations teams through targeted expert guidance during the implementation of developed solutions
- In close collaboration with Audit, Risk, Compliance and Security teams, you address open items and consistently prioritise necessary remediation measures
- Through presentations, workshops and the creation of content, you actively contribute to knowledge sharing around IAM standards and best practices

What you bring to the table:

- A completed university degree in information technology as well as deep expertise in Microsoft Active Directory, DNS and relevant Microsoft technologies
- Strong expertise in integrating on-premises AD with cloud environments such as MS Entra ID for hybrid identity management
- Proficiency in PowerShell or comparable scripting languages for automation and audit queries
- Experience with multi-factor authentication, privileged account management and ideally IT/OT architectures – preferably from the chemical industry
- Relevant certifications (Identity and Access Administrator, CISSP or CISM) are a clear advantage
- Strong communication and influencing skills as well as the ability to independently learn new technologies and act in a solution-oriented manner under pressure
- Good German language skills and fluent English, both written and spoken

This position is generally to be filled on a full-time basis. Would you like to work part-time? Feel free to apply in this case as well, stating your desired percentage.

For initial questions, Chris Rziha (chris.rziha@covestro.com (https://mailto:chris.rziha@covestro.com) ) is happy to help.

Please do not use this email address to send your application or CV. To apply, please click the "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

jobs.occupation: Senior Specialist Global Functional Process Owner O2C - Finance (m/f/d) (Finanzwirt/in)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the center and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface' makes it clear that we are not only focused on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships.

Due to the strategic realignment of the Coatings business unit, a dedicated finance department is being established. This presents an exciting opportunity to develop and shape the finance organization from its foundation. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Specialist Global Functional Process Owner Order-to-Cash Finance with the following objectives:

- You own the global Order-to-cash (O2C) Finance processes, which includes Customer Master Data, Invoicing and Billing, Cash Applications, Collections, Dunning & Accounts Receivable Management.
- You establish and maintain global standards for Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, ensuring these are aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements across the coatings division.
- Moreover, you oversee the O2C activities, identify and drive process improvement opportunities, leveraging technology and digital solutions to enhance automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the finance organization.
- You manage a third-party business process provider in the area of O2C and will implement process performance KPIs to steer the service provider.
- In addition, collaborate closely with related functions such as P2P and B2R, you will coordinate integration efforts and you will ensure holistic alignment of financial processes.
- Last but not least, you engage with internal stakeholders to ensure that O2C processes meet business needs and support strategic objectives.
- university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; additional certifications such as CMA or CPA are an advantage
- at least 10 years of work experience in financial process management and optimization, with a strong focus on O2C activities in a multinational corporation
- experience in the chemicals industry or related industry, particularly during transitions or carve-outs, is highly beneficial
- strong understanding of O2C processes and process optimization methodologies
- proficiency in SAP R/3 and S/4, process mapping tools, and advanced MS Office skills
- excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders in a multicultural environment
- fluency in English is required
- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses or a share program. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage.
- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development.
- As a founding member of the Diversity Charter, BASF stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC and CultiConnect.
- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback.
- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".
- We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week.

jobs.occupation: Lecturer (m/f/d) for North American Studies | Political Science (Lehrer/in/Dozent/in - Erwachsenenbildung)
jobs.description:
Your tasks:

The Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn is an international research university that offers a wide range of degree programs. With more than 200 years of history, about 31.500 students, 700 professors and over 6.000 employees, and an excellent domestic and international reputation, Bonn University is among Germany's leading universities and has been awarded the title Excellence University.

The Department of English, American and Celtic Studies is looking for a fulltime and permanent position as of 01.04.2027

Lecturer (m/f/d) for North American Studies | Political Science

The transdisciplinary North American Studies Program (NAS) at the Institute of English, American and Celtic Studies at the University of Bonn is dedicated to teaching and research about the USA and Canada as cultural, political and economic systems. It offers the MA program North American Studies, cooperates with other disciplines in the BA English Studies and BA of Education English, and regularly organizes extracurricular events such as a lecture series, panel discussions, and symposia.

Your tasks:

- Teaching Political Science with a focus on the United States and Canada (in English) (BA and MA level) (12 SWS),
- Examination procedures in all the above-mentioned degree programs,
- Research activities,
- Cooperation in transdisciplinary projects of the North American Studies program and with other research units at Bonn University that focus on Political Science,
- Responsibility for administrative tasks within the NAS.

Your profile:

Your profile:

- A university degree with a doctorate is required; a second book (Habilitation) or equivalent qualification at the time of appointment is desirable,
- Teaching experience and research activities in the areas of transatlantic relations, foreign and/or domestic policy, and/or the historical development of the political system of the US and Canada; a particular interest in the areas of political cultures and comparative Political Science, as well as in current issues in transdisciplinary research and debates about methodology, is desired,
- Experience in transdisciplinary teaching and cooperative research,
- Very good written and spoken English skills (the language of instruction for the degree programs is English),
- International collaborative networks.

We offer:

We offer:

- A varied and challenging position with one of the biggest employers in the area,
- An inspirational and motivating work atmosphere,
- Sufficient time for your own research,
- Small, highly motivated study groups in a program conducted entirely in English,
- An exciting, challenging, team-oriented position in teaching, research, and scientific management,
- participation in the university-wide pension system (VBL),
- Access to the extensive university sports program,
- A salary based on the TV-L E 13 scale,
- Teaching load: 12 SWS per week (100%),
- Total work load: approx. 39,50 hours per week (100%).

The University of Bonn promotes an open, respectful, and non-discriminatory academic culture and is actively committed to equal opportunity and family friendliness. We aim to eliminate structural disadvantages and to strengthen diversity in research, teaching, and administration. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of ethnic or social background, gender, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, or age.

Applications from women and people with a documented severe disability (or equivalent status) will be given preferential consideration in accordance with the State Equality Act (LGG) NRW and Social Code (SGB) IX.
If you are interested in this position, please send your application documents (cover letter, CV, certificates, list of publications, a research and teaching concept (3 pages max.), a list of courses taught, the results of recent teaching evaluations, and relevant certificates) with the application code 2026/187 by August 31, 2026 – in one single pdf file – to the North American Studies Program: office.nas@uni-bonn.de.

For further questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Sabine N. Meyer (sabine.meyer@uni-bonn.de).

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Global Procurement Process Manager (P2P) (f/m/d), you drive the continuous transformation, harmonization, and governance of global end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay processes across regions, functions, and business units. You collaborate closely with Procurement, Finance, Engineering, and IT teams to design and implement a standardized SAP S/4HANA-based process landscape while advancing strategic transformation initiatives. By leveraging digital technologies such as AI and process mining tools, you identify optimization opportunities, enhance process efficiency, and support the deployment of innovative solutions. Through active stakeholder engagement, performance monitoring, training, and best-practice sharing, you ensure sustainable adoption, continuous improvement, and global alignment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Ownership and continuous development of the global end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process landscape for Direct and Indirect Materials, including process harmonization, standardization, and governance across regions and business units.
* Design, implementation, and monitoring of governance frameworks, compliance standards, and internal control mechanisms to ensure process integrity and regulatory adherence.
* Leadership of global cross-functional transformation initiatives in collaboration with Procurement, Finance, Engineering, and IT stakeholders.
* Optimization and strategic enhancement of procurement systems, particularly SAP S/4HANA, in alignment with the global process and system template.
* Identification and realization of efficiency and automation opportunities through digital technologies, including AI solutions and process mining tools such as Celonis and Signavio, as well as implementation of innovative P2P solutions.
* Performance management, senior stakeholder engagement, best-practice sharing, benchmarking activities, and delivery of training and change communication programs to support organizational transformation.

What You Bring

* University degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Extensive professional experience in global Procurement with a strong focus on end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process management for direct and/or indirect materials.
* Proven track record in leading large-scale process transformation and optimization initiatives within complex international organizations.
* Advanced expertise in SAP S/4HANA, AI-enabled procurement solutions, process mining tools (e.g., Celonis, Signavio), and P2P process optimization.
* Strong capabilities in cross-functional project leadership, governance and compliance management, KPI-driven performance management, stakeholder engagement, change management, and strategic problem-solving.
* Business-fluent German and English language skills.

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme

Building smart, low-code applications that reshape how 30+ manufacturing factories operate every day sounds like a great deal? This is your opportunity to drive meaningful change in an international manufacturing environment where your work directly accelerates operational excellence.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Development of full-scale Mendix applications using Mendix Studio Pro; from domain modeling and microflow logic to UI/UX design to ensure security, performance, and scalability across a global manufacturing network
* Integration of enterprise systems such as SAP and AWS by building reliable RESTful API connections and web services that keep critical business processes running seamlessly
* Leading digital transformation initiatives by converting existing visualization tools into fully functional smart applications, applying the organization's digitalization methodology to automate manual workflows and optimize process chains
* Partnering with business units across 30+ factories to define requirements, manage stakeholder expectations, and translate operational needs into scalable low-code solutions with measurable impact
* Building and nurturing a global Mendix developer community within Grid Technologies factories, acting as a role model for best practices and supporting the full software development lifecycle from testing through to deployment and enhancement

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related technical field
* Many Years of hands-on experience in Mendix development, a Mendix Expert Developer Certification is a plus
